executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Sheraton Guadalajara Expo appeared in at least one AI answer for 47.6% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo appeared 11.9% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Sheraton Guadalajara Expo in the hotel options surfaced.

The clearest strength in this period is often placed near the top when ai ranks hotels. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo appeared in the Top 3 72.7% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Adventure & Experiences.
sections.keyInsight: AI Consideration is 11.9%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara is a leading observed alternative in those gaps — an evidence lead for review, not an automatic proof of recurring substitution. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The binding constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses.
sections.whyItMatters: Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Adventure & Experiences. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.
sections.whatToReview: Compare evidence from scenarios where JW Marriott Hotel Guadalajara appears with the property information currently available for Sheraton Guadalajara Expo. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.
